review.verdict: The right-half chip-to-coins dial metaphor reads cleanly, but the left half is a tangle: the door prop crashes into the crowd figure as an unreadable plank, the sign floats disconnected overhead, and the single crowd figure undersells the scale of the petition — this falls short of publish-ready.
revisionNotes: The door raw-prop (large rotated blue plank on founder's left) overlaps the crowd figure, reading as an ambiguous surfboard/plank rather than a door. Separate anchors — move crowd to x=0.12 and founder to x=0.45 — so the door clears the crowd entirely.
Redraw the door prop with a recognizable frame + narrow leaf and cap rotation under ~15°; at its current size/angle it swallows both figures and breaks the 'walking out' beat.
Founder's 'holds' prop is 'none', but the brief calls for a briefcase — add a briefcase prop to the founder to sell the 'stepping out' beat.
Crowd is a single human at scale 1, undercutting the '100,000 signatures' idea — bump crowd scale to ~1.2 or add a second overlapped figure so it reads as a small group, not one person.

'BRING HIM BACK' label floats as a disconnected banner above the cluster instead of reading as a sign the crowd is holding — attach it directly over the crowd's raised arm/hand so it functions as the hand-lettered sign described in the brief.

The right-side chip→dial→coins cutaway is the clearest, strongest part of the frame — keep that focal treatment, but tighten the left half so it earns equal weight instead of reading as clutter next to it.

warnings: "sign-label" (label) was moved 14 px, 0 px to stay inside the safe area

review.verdict: The cast and yellow-highlight dial land the metaphor, but tangled crowd arms, a door that reads as a cape, a disconnected building, and a coin stack that looks like a trophy drag clarity and polish down, and the blue-blueprint-plus-yellow-dot look repeats recent sloppers too closely to pass today.
revisionNotes: Crowd-back and crowd overlap heavily, their raised arms tangle into what reads as one figure with three arms; widen the gap (crowd-back x 0.12, crowd x 0.30) and drop crowd-back's scale a touch more so each figure is distinct.

The door component is rotated and centered on the founder's torso, so it reads as a cape draped over his shoulder rather than an open door; scale it down, move it fully behind him (side 'left', offset so the frame doesn't cross his body), and keep it upright.

The founder and crowd scene floats disconnected from the building cutaway on the right; add a ground line or extend the building's left wall so it reads as one structure with the exit on the left and the cross-section on the right, not two separate props.
Briefcase prop is hidden behind the door drape; increase its scale and move it to the founder's front hand so it's legible.

The coin stack at the base of the pipe (four stacked ellipses) reads as a trophy or cake tier rather than coins; redraw as a tighter stack of flat disks with visible rim lines so 'growing pile of coins' is unambiguous.

The blue blueprint background with a single yellow accent dot repeats the palette of at least three recent sloppers (the cloud/brain-data piece, the self-improving AI piece); vary the accent color or background treatment to stand out.

warnings: "crowd-back" extends outside the safe area in the final frame (x 52…207, y 523…842)

review.verdict: A narrow pass: the pleading crowd and the hidden scarcity dial are each legible and the cast/kindness are handled well, but a flagged safe-area bleed, an ambiguous briefcase attachment, and heavy reuse of the navy-blueprint building-cutaway motif from recent sloppers keep it from being a strong one.
revisionNotes: Move "crowd-back" inward and scale it down (e.g. x 0.15, scale 0.65) — the lint flag confirms it bleeds past the safe area (x 52-207, y 523-842).

The briefcase prop reads as floating between the cheering crowd figure and the founder; pull it closer to the founder's trailing hand (increase offset or attach on the opposite side) so ownership is unambiguous.

The chip-pipe-dial-coin mechanism needs a beat to parse; bump the yellow dial accent to scale ~1.3 and add one more coin disc to the stack so 'growing pile of money' reads instantly, not just as a schematic.

Give the founder a turned head or a short dashed sightline back toward the crowd to sell the 'glancing back' beat from the brief — currently the stand pose faces forward with no sense of looking back.

Differentiate from recent sloppers: at least two recent pieces (Business As Usual, Self-Improving AI Spending Staff Pay) already use this exact navy-blueprint building-cutaway-plus-chart device; vary the palette accent or building silhouette next time.

Left-side grouping (2 humans + sign + briefcase) is dense relative to the right half; consider widening the gap between crowd and founder so the two vignettes (pleading crowd / hidden dial) separate more cleanly.
